anomalies.description: A chaotic street scene with multiple individuals running, smoke (likely from tear gas or smoke grenades) rising, and a line of uniformed officers in the background; people are actively moving away from the smoke and toward/away from police lines, indicating violent unrest or clash.

In frames f0–f2, at least two individuals on the left appear to be engaged in physical confrontation—grappling or striking—amidst the dispersing crowd and smoke. One person is seen lunging or pushing another near the center-left.

After a brief camera drop (f6–f9), the view returns showing continued unrest: a lone protester stands defiantly holding a sign while smoke lingers, and a hand in the foreground holds a black object (possibly a gas mask filter or shield); background shows dense crowd and police line, consistent with ongoing riot conditions.

A sudden release of a large cloud of white smoke (likely tear gas or smoke canister) occurs in the street near a cyclist and a man in a coat, causing people to react and move away; this is consistent with crowd control during a protest that has escalated into unrest.

A sudden release of a large cloud of white smoke (likely from a smoke canister or tear gas) occurs in the street amid a crowd and police line, causing people to react and move away; this constitutes collective violent unrest with use of crowd-control agents.
